deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is a German-language autobiographical/planning passage inserted between pages of notes on 1-dimensional arrangements of pseudolines (the previous and next pages list crucial configurations: pencils plus a secant, two pencils, simple arrangements of 4 and 5 pseudolines). Grothendieck is weighing practical questions about a planned introspective 'meditation' on his life.

(1) Language. He wonders whether to write the directly autobiographical parts in French. He asks whether in-depth meditations based on German-language material should also be in French. The preceding page, not supplied, apparently mentions someone who reads German.

(2) Two approaches at once. He considers running 'the two approaches above' simultaneously: starting a chronological investigation of his life right away, while also reading a correspondence. That correspondence is very probably the letters of 'Hanka', i.e. his mother Johanna (Hanka) Grothendieck, likely with his father Sascha. Hence the German-language source material.

(3) A worry and a plan. He fears that, working chronologically, he would constantly be trying to piece together memories that do not exist. If he instead starts from a core period or from the source material, central questions would arise and be examined, and might push other periods forward for investigation. Once the core period or source material had been worked through, the time might be 'riper' to follow a chronological order.

This fits his documented late-1970s/early-1980s turn to meditation on his parents, the precursor of 'La Clef des Songes' and of the material he later called 'Mes parents'. It sits on sheets interleaved with the pseudoline notes, apparently reused paper or a parallel diary.

ideas.what: Methodological plan for an autobiographical meditation: begin from a core period or primary documents (his parents' correspondence) rather than strict chronology; choice of French vs German for writing
ideas.where_published: Related themes appear in Récoltes et Semailles (introductory parts on meditation) and in the circulated La Clef des Songes / notes on his parents; this specific passage is unsure

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely biographical and gives no mathematics. It is of minor interest to biographers, as evidence that around 1981 the parents' correspondence project was interleaved with the pseudoline notes. Nothing on it bears on the mathematical record.
transcription_corrections: 'Lektüre eines[?] meines[?] Briefwechsels mit Hanh.[?]': the last word is most likely 'Hanka' (abbreviated 'Hank.'), his mother's name, not 'Hanh'. The possessive is uncertain (possibly 'unseres'/'meiner'), and the correspondence is likely that of his parents.
'eingehende Meditationen' should probably read 'eingehenden Meditationen' (doch eingehenden Meditationen insbesondere an Hand von deutschsprachigem Material, auf Französisch?).
'zusammenzubasteln[?]': the image suggests 'zusammenzu-' followed on the next line by a short word ending in '-ken'/'-ben' ('zusammenzuweben'/'zusammenzuflicken'?). It remains uncertain.

'möglicherweise in andere Perioden [-sicht...-] zur Untersuchung aufdrängen' should read roughly 'möglicherweise sich andere Perioden zur Untersuchung aufdrängen' (the struck-through text is 'sicht...' followed by 'zur').
The final word 'Jedenfalls' is correct; the sentence continues on the next sheet.
